name: Wall, diagonal run
description: Diagonal Stone Wall (point 41, m-hradby-diagonala). diagonal: a tile in the middle of a run – a band turned 45°, as thick as the straight wall, corner to corner, parapets on both sides. elbow-<corner>-<z><x>: the tile where a run ends – the straight wall and half of the band meet in a mitre (no corner sticking out), parapets along the whole outline. All drawn on the tile centre. Made by Claude with the wall-kit generator at the owner's request (15 Nov 2026); waits for the owner's approval.
